title.narrative: Niue High School Participation at the 51st New Zealand Secondary Schools Track and Field Championship 2024

description.narrative: Niue High School plans to send a small contingent of its top athletes to participate at the 51st New Zealand Secondary Schools' Track, Field and 48th Road Race Championships 2024, to be held in Timaru New Zealand, on the 6th – 8th December 2024. We have participated at past games with much success, where our students are able to compete against their peers in Athletics disciplines. Popular for us are the throwing field events like the discus and the javelin. There are plenty of natural throwers at our school and exposing them to competition at a high level will elevate them to a time when they will become great ambassadors for Niue, through sports. We have always nurtured high achievers academically with recognition and scholarships. This is one way of nurturing, recognising, and promoting athletic talent and ability of our sports-oriented students.
